mapper.sql: p.phone AS patientPhone, CASE WHEN p.gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN p.gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS patientGender, CASE WHEN p.id_card IS NULL OR p.id_card = '' THEN NULL WHEN LENGTH(p.id_card) = 18 THEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(SUBSTRING(p.id_card, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED) WHEN LENGTH(p.id_card) = 15 THEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - CAST(CONCAT('19', SUBSTRING(p.id_card, 7, 2)) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS patientAge, p.system_user_id AS patientUserId
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.patient_id AS patientId, r.registration_status AS registrationStatus, r.create_time AS createTime, p.real_name AS patientName, , COALESCE(dept.department_name, s.department_name) AS departmentName, COALESCE(d.real_name, s.doctor_name) AS doctorName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, CASE WHEN s.is_morning = 1 THEN '上午' WHEN s.is_afternoon = 1 THEN '下午' END AS timePeriod FROM registration r JOIN patient_attendant p ON r.patient_id = p.id JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN doctor_detail d ON r.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sub_department dept ON d.sub_department_id = dept.id WHERE r.id = #{registrationId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0
